title: KAN_synth
summary: An open-source Python package that replaces the MLP layers of CTGAN and TVAE with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) components to generate synthetic tabular data for an undergraduate thesis. It subclasses ctgan's BaseSynthesizer and DataTransformer directly and uses sdgym to benchmark the resulting KAN-based models against the original CTGAN/TVAE architectures.
evidence: src/KAN_synth/models/Hybrid_TVAE_code.py:38-39 imports ctgan.data_transformer.DataTransformer and ctgan.synthesizers.base.BaseSynthesizer, subclassed to build KAN variants
needs: Benchmarks.py lists 'GaussianCopulaSynthesizer' in a comparison list but no sdv.* import is shown, so it's unclear whether SDV proper (vs. ctgan/sdgym alone) is actually invoked for that model.
